spring:
  application:
    name: board-api
  datasource:
    # javaExperience MySQL(호스트 3306)의 project DB. 빈 DB면 Flyway가 V1으로 테이블·시드를 만든다
    url: jdbc:mysql://localhost:13308/project?characterEncoding=UTF-8&serverTimezone=Asia/Seoul
    username: community
    password: community
  jpa:
    hibernate:
      # 스키마는 Flyway만 만든다. 엔티티가 테이블과 다르면 기동이 실패한다
      ddl-auto: validate
    open-in-view: false

app:
  jwt:
    # 예시용 비밀키 — 실제 서비스에서는 코드·저장소에 두지 않고 환경 변수 등으로 주입한다. HS256은 32바이트 이상
    secret: board-api-example-secret-key-change-me-0123456789
    validity-seconds: 3600
mybatis:
  mapper-locations: classpath:mapper/*.xml
  configuration:
    map-underscore-to-camel-case: true

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8" ?>
<!DOCTYPE mapper PUBLIC "-//mybatis.org//DTD Mapper 3.0//EN" "https://mybatis.org/dtd/mybatis-3-mapper.dtd">
<mapper namespace="org.example.board.post.PostQueryMapper">
    <sql id="columns">
        p.id, p.title, p.visibility, p.view_count, p.like_count, p.created_at,
        u.id AS author_id, u.nickname AS author_nickname
    </sql>

    <sql id="visibleWhere">
        p.deleted_at IS NULL
        AND (p.visibility = 'PUBLIC'
        <if test="loginUserId != null">OR p.author_id = #{loginUserId}</if>)
        <if test="cond.tag != null">
            AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM post_tags pt JOIN tags t ON t.id = pt.tag_id
                        WHERE pt.post_id = p.id AND t.name = #{cond.tag})
        </if>
        <if test="cond.q != null">AND p.title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{cond.q}, '%')</if>
    </sql>

    <sql id="sortOrder">
        <choose>
            <when test="cond.sort == 'popular'">ORDER BY p.like_count DESC, p.id DESC</when>
            <otherwise>ORDER BY p.id DESC</otherwise>
        </choose>
    </sql>

    <select id="findPage" resultType="org.example.board.post.PostListRow">
        SELECT <include refid="columns"/>
        FROM posts p JOIN users u ON u.id = p.author_id
        <where><include refid="visibleWhere"/></where>
        <include refid="sortOrder"/>
        LIMIT #{cond.size} OFFSET #{offset}
    </select>

    <select id="count" resultType="long">
        SELECT COUNT(*) FROM posts p
        <where><include refid="visibleWhere"/></where>
    </select>

    <select id="findAfterCursor" resultType="org.example.board.post.PostListRow">
        SELECT <include refid="columns"/>
        FROM posts p JOIN users u ON u.id = p.author_id
        <where>
            <include refid="visibleWhere"/>
            <if test="cursorId != null">AND p.id < #{cursorId}</if>
        </where>
        ORDER BY p.id DESC
        LIMIT #{limit}
    </select>

    <select id="findTagsByPostIds" resultType="org.example.board.post.PostTagRow">
        SELECT pt.post_id AS postId, t.name
        FROM post_tags pt JOIN tags t ON t.id = pt.tag_id
        WHERE pt.post_id IN
        <foreach collection="postIds" item="id" open="(" separator="," close=")">#{id}</foreach>
        ORDER BY t.name
    </select>
</mapper>
